spell.irons_spellbooks.recall.guide: Return to your respawn point. Use it to get home from a distant island.
spell.irons_spellbooks.teleport.guide: Blink a short distance to reposition. This spell has one rank and a base cooldown of 20 seconds.
spell.irons_spellbooks.angel_wing.guide: Glide like an elytra for up to 50 seconds. Wait at least two minutes between activations.
spell.irons_spellbooks.portal.guide: Place both ends of a temporary portal with two casts. The ends can be up to 128 blocks apart in the same dimension. Wait at least three minutes between completed pairs.
puffish_skills.aeroscapes_reimagine.magi: Extinguish yourself and visible allies in Frostwave’s area. The wave also puts out exposed ordinary fire.
After your health is restored, excess healing from Blood Needles goes to one wounded undead within 8 blocks that you summoned with Raise Dead.
An Arcane Shackle cast into an empty spot on solid ground leaves a chain marker for up to 8 seconds. It tethers the first eligible hostile to approach within 3 blocks. You can maintain one marker.
Aim at a friendly player in sight within 8 blocks to cast Oakskin on them. With no eligible target, the spell protects you.
